Do you know how your hair grows so fast? Or why humans look different from monkeys today? Have you ever thought why we drink water every day and why our body sweats when it gets hot?
In this video, we will answer all these amazing questions about the human body and evolution in a simple, exciting, and easy way that kids will love to learn! Get ready for cool facts, surprising answers, and a journey inside our wonderful body!
